title: gpt-5-codex-medium shows reasoning none
body: ### What version of Codex is running? codex-cli 0.42.0 ### Which model were you using? gpt-5-codex-medium ### What platform is your computer? Darwin 25.0.0 arm64 arm ### What steps can reproduce the bug? 1. /models -> chose gpt-5-codex-medium 2. /status -> shows "reasoning none" ### What is the expected behavior? status should show "reasoning medium" ### What do you see instead? "reasoning none" ### Additional information

linked_prs.title: fix: set gpt-5-codex medium preset reasoning

ai_judgment.response: Yes. The issue involves the usage of an LLM model (gpt-5-codex-medium) and concerns unexpected model behavior ("reasoning none" instead of "reasoning medium"), which aligns with the criteria for LLM operation issues in agent systems.
